message:
feat: unify changelog prompt logic and support freeform mode

WHY
The changelog generation was restricted to specific modes and relied on an outdated prompt template that did not support freeform user instructions. Additionally, the removal of changelog_areas.md caused template retrieval errors.

WHAT
* Updated GenerateChangelogGrouped to support 'freeform' mode.
* Switched prompt template from 'changelog_areas' to 'changelog' to unify logic.
* Added GetChangelog to retrieve the standard changelog template.
* Updated GetChangelogAreas to fallback to the changelog template.
author: blak0p
